title: History Rail & Diff Viewer
description: Build the version history UI panel showing snapshot timeline, and a diff viewer for comparing two versions. Includes snapshot list with timestamps/labels, inline diff display with additions/deletions highlighted, and restore confirmation dialog.
action: Create desktop/src/components/HistoryPanel.tsx with snapshot timeline and diff viewer. Use 'diff' npm package for Myers diff computation. Integrate into DocumentEditor layout as a collapsible side panel.

convergence.verification: History panel opens as side rail, lists snapshots with timestamps, selecting two snapshots shows inline diff with color-coded additions/deletions, restore button works with confirmation
convergence.definition_of_done: History panel renders snapshot list, diff viewer shows text changes between versions, restore confirmed via dialog, panel toggles from editor toolbar

files.change: New component with snapshot timeline, diff viewer, restore confirmation dialog
Add historyPanelOpen (boolean, default false), toggleHistoryPanel action
Add HistoryPanel to layout, toggle button in toolbar, conditional rendering

implementation: 1. Extend uiSlice.ts: add historyPanelOpen: boolean (default false), toggleHistoryPanel(), setHistoryPanelOpen(value) actions
2. Create HistoryPanel.tsx: main container component with two views — snapshot list and diff viewer
3. Snapshot list: call listSnapshots(projectId, chapterId), render as timeline with timestamp, label (if named), file size
4. Diff viewer: accept fromSnapshotId and toSnapshotId, call diffSnapshots(), render inline diff with additions (green bg) and deletions (red bg)
5. DiffLine component: renders single diff line with type (added/removed/unchanged), line number, content
6. Restore button: on click, show confirmation dialog (modal), on confirm call restoreSnapshot(), update editor content
7. Integrate into DocumentEditor.tsx: add HistoryPanel to right side of layout (width 320px), toggle button in toolbar using clock/history icon
8. Install 'diff' npm package: npm install diff (for Myers diff algorithm, used by versionService.diffSnapshots)
test: Component tests: renders empty history, renders snapshot list, selects two snapshots shows diff, restore triggers confirmation. Integration: history panel toggles, diff display accurate, restore updates editor content
reference: F-002 (Version History & Revision Tracking), versionService.ts API surface
rationale: Completes the version history feature by providing user-facing UI for browsing and comparing snapshots
risks: Large diffs could cause rendering lag — add virtualization for very long diffs
Diff package size — diff.js is ~30KB gzipped, acceptable for desktop app
